title.narrative: Raising Incomes of Small and Medium Farmers Project

description.narrative: The project will reduce the market and business risks for small and medium farmers who diversify into high-value commodities (HVCs) in 10 districts of Nepal's Mid-Western Development Region and Far-Western Development Region.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Increased production of HVCs by small and medium farmers

At least 70 AGF subproject on farm development successfully completed by 2019. Achievement: 281 Progress/Status: 281 subprojects related to on-farm development operational at project end. Data Source: DADO annual monitoring reports for farmer group and post-harvest investment

By 2019, at least 110 post-harvest grants and 100 cooperatives and 30 Farmers Groups Coordination Committees (FGCCs) with HVCs supply contracts and 90 DP/IP/DGMF groups successfully completed AGF sub-projects. Achievement: 645 Progress/Status: • 110 post-harvest related grants awarded to agri-entrepreneurs and cooperatives, of which 100 subprojects were successfully completed • 216 AGF grants awarded to subprojects run by cooperatives operational at project end • 280 AGF grants awarded to subprojects run by DP/IP/DGMF groups operational at project end. Data Source: DADO annual monitoring reports for farmer group and post-harvest investment

By 2019, small and medium sized farmers with 7,500 ha of supply agreements have increased their returns by 30% from high value commodities. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Awarded 645 supply agreements increasing additional 8074 ha of land for HVC production. ADB PCR will assess the return of small and medium sized farmers from the HVCs.
